Mobile: 8554084768 Email: alonerider1990@gmail.com

Shreeyash Vasing DOB: 20-06-83

SNAPSHOT:

Over 19 years of experience in a competitive global sales environment and currently holding a UK skilled worker visa & US B1 visa. I have gained knowledge of Consulting, Application, Engineering, Cloud, Analytics, ERP, Data & Quality assurance & Testing, RPA, IOT, AI & ML, Mobility, Automation, Assurance & Risk Controls, IT products & solutions. I have served global BFSI, GCC, CPG, Automotive, Telco, Media, BSS, Contact Center, and entertainment industry players. I have leveraged various sources to generate revenue for the IT Product based Consulting & Managed Services business. Gained expertise in Account Management, Sales planning, and Vendor/Partner Management & Revenue Maximization is also proficient in Sales enablement, Team Management & driving entire sales cycles. Possess excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills with proven abilities in customer relationship management. A motivated achiever consistently exceeded sales goals. I am a positively aggressive and conceptual thinker.

CAREER SCAN:

Organization: Sopra Steria, UK/India - Hybrid Designation: General Manager, Sales – July 2022 till July 2026

Responsible for selling Sopra's IT solutions & services to GCC, Banking, Retail, CPG, Media, Telco, Manufacturing, Logistics and Automotive global players.

Partner network management responsibilities with OEMs, Hyperscalers & resellers like SAP, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce and GSIs.

Sold four in-house cloud solutions and IT services around Digital, cloud, application, security, and infrastructure.

On boarded new logos from various industries while booking TCV of £5.6m in 2025 with an annual target of £6m, achieved £5.2m with an annual target of £5m in 2024 and achieved £4.1m in 2023 with an annual target of £4m.

Managed the UK, EU & India region while having a team of 4 sales managers.

Organization: PWC, (Price Waterhouse Coopers), Pune Designation: Associate Director – A/C Management & Sales from July 2020 to July 2022

Managed GCC from Banking, Energy, Telecom, Retail, CPG & financial services accounts from a sales & account management perspective.

OEM partnership responsibilities with SAP, MS, AWS, GCP, SF, Cisco, Dell, Core banking providers & Global system integrators.

Responsible for generating £7.5m order booking & renewals for risk assurance BU and overachieved target by £700K.

Single point of contact for dedicated 6 major global UK based accounts and while managing 5 sales managers.

Organization: Wipro Technologies, Mumbai Designation: Manager – Key Account Management from Aug 2019 to July 2020

Revenue generation responsibility from IT consulting services around AI, Digital, Cloud, Applications, Infrastructure, managed services, cyber security and automation services.

Key Account Manager for all seven entities of the HDFC group. ● Sold IT services for OEM players like SAP, Oracle, AWS, Salesforce, Cisco, VMware, UiPath & partnership responsibilities with other major OEM players.

Organization: Experian - Mumbai Designation: Sales Manager - BFSI from June 2016 to Aug 2019

Responsible for positioning Experian’s cloud and on-premises products and services like DaaS - Decision as a Service, Marketing services platform, Data Quality Platform (Pandora) & other Credit Bureau products.

Served large BFSI organizations, Captives, leading retail players, Telco, aircraft maintenance and real estate clients.

Worked with cross functional teams, multiple Business units and delivery teams.

Organization: Blink Consulting (Oracle partners), Pune Designation: Manager Sales from Feb 2011 to June 2016

Joined as an IC and promoted in just one year as a manager for soliciting IT



managed services around Oracle platforms, managed 2 sales members in 2013. I had the responsibility of running the entire sales cycle for the North American region to secure new logos and account management for major existing clients.

Secured $370k of $500k target in 2011, $860k of $800k target in 2012, $1.25m of $1m target in 2013, $1.66m of $1.5m target in 2014 & $910k of $1m target in 2015. ● Awarded three times as a sales performer and worked as a liaison between the India

Delivery team and the Dallas, Texas leadership team.

Organization: Aptech Limited - Pune Designation: Channel Sales Executive from June 2008 to Feb 2011

Orchestration of an opportunity while leveraging a network of channel partners to generate royalty-based revenue.

Handled 39 centers in the India out of which 12 new partnerships commenced by me in 26





months duration. I had a responsibility to explore engagement opportunities from Corporate & Partner development. Individual contributor role but worked closely with delivery, quality, legal, audit & top leadership team.

Constantly achieved revenue targets 101% in FY09, 115% in FY10 and 105% in FY11.

Academia, Training & Certifications:

Masters of Personnel Management degree from Pune University 2005 till 2007 ● PRINCE2 - Practitioner Certified from the Axelos United Kingdom 2021



Six Sigma - Green Belt certification from Indian Statistical Institute 2022
